text:
The female doctor personally explained the procedure and suggested dosage.

The picosecond laser treatment started with low energy, which was less painful, but later it went up to high energy. My whole face was flushed after the treatment, which was quite scary. It cost 3999 yuan, plus a 3% handling fee for credit card payments.

The numbing cream was applied for an hour, the treatment itself lasted 5 minutes, and the most painful part was when the numbing cream wore off in half an hour (I even regretted getting such a strong treatment).

The service was good, and the place was clean and tidy. The staff's English wasn't very good, which made communication a little inconvenient. Otherwise, it was similar to my experience with cosmetic procedures in Taiwan and South Korea.

I hope I'll be very grateful to this place once my skin recovers and looks beautiful.
